Ecclesie Thessalonicensium: to the church of the Thessalonians
in Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Chris: in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Gratia vobis et pax a Deo: Grace unto you, and peace from God
Gratias agere: We are bound to give thanks
debemus Deo: We are bound to give thanks always to God
semper pro vobis, fratres, ita ut dignum: always for you, brethren, as it is fitting.
et abundat caritas uniuscuiusque omnium: and the charity of every one of you towards each other, aboundeth
gloriemur in Ecclesiis Dei: glory in the churches of God
in exemplum iusti iudicii Dei,: For an example of the just judgment of God
IN EXEMPLUM IUSTI IUDICII DEI: For an example of the just judgment of God
ut digni habeamini in regno Dei,: that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God
Si tamen iustum est: Seeing it is a just thing
et vobis qui tribulamini requiem nobiscu: And to you who are troubled, rest with us
in revelatione Domini Iesu: when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed
cum angelis virtutis eius: with the angels of his power
non noverunt Deum et qui non obediunt: know not God, and who obey not
Domini et a gloria virtutis eius,: of the Lord, and from the glory of his power
venerit glorificari in sanctis suis: he shall come to be glorified in his saints
et admirabilis fieri in omnibus: and to be made wonderful in all
quia testimonium nostrum creditum est su: because our testimony was believed upon you
In quo oramus etiam semper pro vobis ut: Wherefore also we pray always for you; that our God would make you worthy of his vocation
impleat omnem voluntatem bonitatis: fulfill all the good pleasure of his goodness
opus fidei in virtute: the work of faith in power
nomen Domini nostri Iesu Christi in vobi: the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him
per adventum Domini nostri Iesu Christi: by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ
ut non cito moveamini: That you be not easily moved
neque terreamini neque per spiritum,: nor be terrified, neither by spirit
neque per sermonem, neque per epistolam: nor by word, nor by epistle
as if the day of the Lord were at hand
supra omne quod dicitur Deus: above all that is called God
ita ut in templo Dei: so that he sitteth in the temple of God
quoniam nisi venerit discessio primum: for unless there come a revolt first
revelatus fuerit homo peccati: the man of sin be revealed
quod cum adhuc essem apud vos, hec: that when I was yet with you, I told you these things
Nam mysterium iam operatur iniquitatis,: For the mystery of iniquity already worketh
do hold, until he be taken out of the way
DE MEDIO FIAT: be taken out of the way
quem Dominus Iesus interficiet spiritu o: whom the Lord Jesus shall kill with the spirit of his mouth
SPIRITU ORIS: with the spirit of his mouth
est adventus secundum operationem Satane: coming is according to the working of Satan
et in omni seductione iniquitatis: And in all seduction of iniquity
eo quod caritatem: because they receive not the love
they receive not, that they might be saved
qui non crediderunt veritati: who have not believed the truth
debemus gratias agere semper Deo pro vob: ought to give thanks to God always for you, brethren, beloved of God, for that God hath chosen
per evangelium nostrum in acquisitionem: by our gospel, unto the purchasing
Ipse autem Dominus noster Iesus Christus: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God
et Pater noster qui dilexit nos: and our Father, who hath loved us
et dedit consolationem eternam: and hath given us everlasting consolation
De cetero, fratres, orate pro nobis, ut: For the rest, brethren, pray for us, that the word of God
et ut liberemur: And that we may be delivered
for all men have not faith
quoniam que precipimus et facitis et fac: that the things which we command, you both do, and will do
vobis, fratres in nomine Domini nostri I: brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
secundum traditionem quam acceperunt a n: according to the tradition which they have received of us
panem manducavimus ab aliquo,: did we eat any man's bread
nocte et die operantes, ne quem vestrum: we worked night and day, lest we should be chargeable to any of you
Non quasi non habuerimus potestatem,: Not as if we had not power
ut nosmet ipsos formam daremus vobis: that we might give ourselves a pattern unto you
QUONIAM SI QUIS NON VULT OPERARI: If any man will not work
inter vos quosdam ambulare inquiete nihi: there are some among you who walk disorderly, working not at all, but curiously meddling
His autem qui eiusmodi sunt denuntiamus: Now we charge them that are such, and beseech them by the Lord Jesus Christ, that, working with silence
operantes suum panem: they would eat their own bread
Vos autem, fratres, nolite deficerebenef: But you, brethren, be not weary in well doing
Quod si quis non obedit verbo: And if any man obey not our word
per epistolam hunc notate,: by this epistle, note that man
et non commisceamini cum illo ut confund: and do not keep company with him, that he may be ashamed
nolite quasi inimicum existimare,: do not esteem him as an enemy
but admonish him as a brother
Ipse autem Dominus pacis det vobis pacem: Now the Lord of peace himself give you everlasting peace
The Lord be with you all
mea manu Pauli, quod est signum in omni: The salutation of Paul with my own hand; which is the sign in every epistle. So I write
